statement: Daily counts of NYC 311 service requests by New York calendar day of created_date, from NYC Open Data's dataset erm2-nwe9 (311 Service Requests from 2020 to Present), per problem type and community board of the frozen 2024 frame, counted by one anonymous query per day: the context days 2025-09-01 to 2026-06-02 on 2026-10-16 UTC, the target days 2026-06-03 to 2026-08-31 on 2026-10-17 UTC. The dataset's metadata states no licence and gives the attribution 311. The City's website terms of use, read 2026-10-17, say nothing specific about datasets (reports/study3-nyc311/panel/source-terms.md). Source: NYC Open Data; no endorsement by the City of New York is claimed. CC BY 4.0 applies to the project's compilation (the selection, the derived fields, the documentation), not to the counts as such.
